reconstruction.scope: Complete small birch roundwood footbridge: transverse pale-log deck, two longitudinal stringers, paired four-post railings with two round rails and diagonal branch braces, two bank sills and coarse dark bark patches. Original geometry and shared wood_plain material graph, with four authored LODs. No private texture atlas, copied photo pixels, invented pond or excavated channel. Hidden joinery and support sizes are reconstructed.
